title: My first Game with AI
author: smyter05
selftext:
Its so fun coding with chatgpt i always wanted to program my own games but was never able to do code, and now that i can do something like that without knowing code is so fun. heres my first game i came up with its a tower defense rouge like game but with own ideas and implementations  
i just have fun making up own ideas and then getting them into the game  
the game is currently on v0.3 and im planning to publish it when its really really perfect i have sooooo much more ideas i just wanted to share this maybe someone has some good ideas too or wants to try this version then reach out to me🫡

also documenting my journey on youtube
